title: Ones & Zeros
description: Conway's Game of Life, alive in colour. Every new cell blinks in as a 1 and inherits a blend of the three colours that made it, then softens into a glowing dot as it survives — and flashes 0 the moment it dies. Draw with your finger, drop gliders, pulsars and a glider gun, and watch rainbow colonies spread, collide and burn out.
